environment.temp: owned disposable TMPDIR, removed after run

prerequisite_failure.boundary: fixture git clone --shared --no-checkout failed before assertions: partial-clone promised blob unavailable with lazy fetching disabled
prerequisite_failure.repair: Hydrate objects in the owned submodule without changing pinned HEAD; no source or foreign checkout edits.

limits: Single compiler suite only, not full CI
Fixture output counts are not production task completion
No measured CPU peak, memory peak or machine-wide resource enforcement

later_source_comparison.meaning: Limited source comparison, not re-stamping the full suite onto a later candidate
